title: A declared name is one edit away from `nimble_parsec`
description: mix.lock declares a locked package name in mix.lock within one edit of `nimble_parsec`. The lockfile records what Mix will fetch, so a name that only looks like the intended package is installed without any earlier review step. The name this rule expects is `nimble_parsec`.
remediation: Confirm the intended name against the package documentation the project already trusts and pin the declaration to that exact name; a name that is one edit away from a widely used package is a typo until the project can show it published the name itself. If the declaration was meant to be `nimble_parsec`, correct it to that exact spelling.
limitation: It compares declared names with `nimble_parsec` by Levenshtein distance of one and reports a name that is not `nimble_parsec` itself; it cannot tell whether the similarly spelled package exists, who publishes it, whether it is malicious, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
